therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: cell cycle arrest and tumor cell proliferation inhibition
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Adult patients with metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Percentage of participants achieving disease control at or before 12 weeks

biomarker_changes: Mean percentage change from baseline in PSA at 12 weeks: 42.661-84.330% across arms
Median time to PSA progression: 5.1-10.9 weeks across arms
subgroup_findings: Arm C showed highest radiographic response rate: 80.0% (95% CI: 54.1–93.1%)
Arm C showed longest median time to radiographic progression: 57.0 weeks (95% CI: 19.1–96.1)
safety_signals: DLTs occurred in 11/72 participants across arms
Serious infections including sepsis (3 cases), pneumonia, enterocolitis
Hematologic toxicities: neutropenia, thrombocytopenia, anemia, febrile neutropenia
results.dose_information: Multiple dosing arms tested with different schedules (Arms A, B, C with 21-day or 14-day cycles)

context.duration: Treatment up to approximately 100-110 weeks, follow-up up to approximately 27 months
